title: aster microcephalus f. albidus
intro: Aster microcephalus f. albidus, commonly known as White Alpine Aster, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of White Alpine Aster include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
